paper.title: Lamin A/C maintains genome topology and regulates transcriptional programs essential for virus-driven B cell activation

perturbation.clone_note: No single-cell cloning or clone identifiers described; lentiviral sgRNA-transduced pool.
perturbation.quote: sgRNA sequences used were as follows: Control: ATTTCGCAGATCATCGACAT, LMNA: AGTTTAAGGAGCTGAAAGCG

control.quote: B cells were transduced with lentiviruses expressing sgRNAs as previously described
control.note: Control is the same LCL transduced with a control sgRNA, referred to as 'WT' in Results; not an untransduced parental line.

replicates_note: No 'n =' or replicate count stated for Hi-C anywhere in Methods or figure legends. Methods state only '5 x 10^6 cells per condition were collected for in-situ Hi-C'. GEO page was CAPTCHA-blocked so sample counts were not confirmed.
depth_note: No read counts or valid-pair counts reported. Only: 'Libraries were sequenced using the Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing platform with paired-end 75 bp read length.' (Methods - Hi-C assay)
enzyme_note: No restriction enzyme named. Protocol given by reference only: 'Hi-C assay was performed as previously described'.

pipeline.name: HiC-Pro
pipeline.quote: HiC data were preprocessed using HiC-Pro v2.10.0 pipeline with default settings using the human genome at 1 kb resolution.
pipeline.differential_contacts: DESeq2 on raw count matrix files; significant interactions summed by cell type and filtered by CTCF binding

compartment_method.processing_resolution: 1 kb (HiC-Pro preprocessing resolution; no separate compartment bin size given)
compartment_method.quote: Eigenvector in WT versus lamin A/C KO cells from Hi-C data sets showing significant (p < 0.01) changes in open (A) and closed chromatin (B) compartments
compartment_method.note: No compartment/eigenvector caller named (no cooltools, HOMER, Juicer, FAN-C or dcHiC). No PC1 sign-orientation rule (GC content or gene density) described.

compartment_findings.units: counts of compartments/regions; no genome fraction or percentage given
compartment_findings.saddle_note: The word 'saddle' does not appear in the full text.
compartment_findings.quote: the depletion of lamin A/C had a significant effect on global genome organization, with 39 compartments switching from B (inactive chromatin) to A (active chromatin) compartments and 23 from A to B in lamin A/C KO cells
compartment_findings.link_note: Compartment changes are never related to LADs or lamin B1. The lamin B1 link is made for CTCF only.

loop_findings.quote: increased frequency of smaller chromatin loops (occurring between nearby regions) and a decreased occurrence of larger loops

ctcf_periphery_lamin_b1_claim.quote: lamin A/C influences the nuclear positioning and transcription of CTCF-bound loci by preventing their relocation to the periphery and their association with lamin B1

supporting_quotes.quote: In absence of lamin A/C, CTCF became repositioned towards the nuclear periphery
We observed increased interaction of CTCF with both lamin B1 and H3K9me2 in the absence of lamin A/C (Fig. 4A).

ctcf_periphery_lamin_b1_claim.evidence_type: proximity ligation assay (PLA) / imaging, not a genome-wide lamin B1 map

quotes.quote: the depletion of lamin A/C had a significant effect on global genome organization

significant three-dimensional reorganization of the genome, evidenced by the loss of long-range chromatin loops, an increase in short-range contacts, and redistribution of H3K9me2-marked heterochromatin
loss of lamin A/C causes the heterochromatin to be untethered to the nuclear periphery, disrupting its supporting role

global_effect_reported.note: Genome-wide contact-scaling shift (short-range up, long-range down) requires distance-matched or quantile-normalized comparison in any tile-level compartment test.

lmnb1_data_in_same_cells.quote: These cells show no differences compared to WT cells in terms of lamin B1 expression or the number of EBV genomes per cell (Fig. S1A and S1B).
lmnb1_data_in_same_cells.data_availability_quote: The RNA-seq, the ChIP-seq and Hi-C datasets generate during this study are available in the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) repository, under accession number GSE314558.
lmnb1_data_in_same_cells.note: No LMNB1 ChIP-seq, CUT&RUN or DamID track exists for these cells; an external LAD/LMNB1 reference would be required.

prior_comparison_found.closest_quote: Lamin A/C is associated with maintaining nuclear structure and organizing chromatin by forming lamina-associated domains (LADs).
prior_comparison_found.note: No statement in the paper compares acute lamina-sensitivity (rate or magnitude of LMNB1 loss) with compartment shift toward B. The hypothesis appears unclaimed by this paper.

sources_unavailable.reason: reCAPTCHA interstitial; sample/replicate metadata not retrieved
